description: Option C would restrict left turns for area businesses.

chips.text: Defeated

Businesses like Tim Hortons, McDonald's, Co-op would lose left-turn access.
Committee members raised concerns about business impact, despite staff recommendation.
Staff could not forecast business traffic loss from restricted left turns.
